name: Absent Human Backstop
definition: No human authority can halt, reverse, or reinterpret automated execution, so cryptographic or procedural correctness substitutes for trust and fails to produce it.
trigger_conditions: No named party can halt execution
No escalation path exists from automated outcome to human judgment
Human interpretation is not stated to prevail where the two diverge

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: without a decentralized human backstop to code, cryptographic security does not create trust between principals and agents

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F016 Absent Human Backstop. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F016
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
